metadata.description: The support agency for ClickHouse on an agent realm: a customer-side gate and a vendor-side desk.

plugins.name: support-gate
plugins.description: For the customer: answer a support agent's requests about your ClickHouse, with your yes on each one, and never send your data.

plugins.name: support-desk
plugins.description: For the support team: work a case through the realm with typed questions, a diagnosis and a proposed fix.
